children: Palmer Square Capital BDC declared a $0.02 supplemental dividend for Q3 2026, payable Oct 13 to shareholders of record as of Sept 25.
Board declared a third-quarter 2026 supplemental dividend of $0.02 per share.
Supplemental dividend payable Oct 13, 2026 to shareholders of record on Sept 25, 2026.
Payment funded from excess quarterly undistributed net investment income above the $0.36 base dividend.
Base dividend of $0.36 per share for Q3 2026 is also payable Oct 13, 2026 to same record date.
